placements.title: heading-to-id/slug derivation must degrade gracefully on malformed or missing input, not merely succeed on the well-formed case
placements.frame: Does this expression test, guarantee, or newly evidence that id/slug derivation from headings survives a malformed, missing-id, or production-observed edge case without crashing while still emitting a valid slug?
